summary: CODE REVIEW PASS — WP-003 POST /api/projects/:slug/reset (handleResetProject). All 7 acceptance criteria confirmed by direct code inspection. Implementation is clean, idiomatic, and consistent with existing GUI API conventions. Key findings: (1) handleResetProject exported at api.ts:537 with correct return type union (ProjectResetDiagnosis | ProjectResetResult). (2) ResetRequestSchema (Zod) correctly validates the body — safeParse + validationError pattern consistent with other handlers. (3) dry_run=true returns diagnosis with no writes — analyzeProjectForReset called, store not written. (4) dry_run=false with decisions calls applyProjectReset and returns result. (5) dry_run=false without decisions: guard `!decisions || Object.keys(decisions).length === 0` correctly returns 400. (6) assertSafeSlug + ledgerDirExists + notFound correctly handles invalid/missing slug (404). (7) Route wired in server.ts in a dedicated POST block (lines 351–382) ahead of matchRoute() — architecturally correct because the endpoint requires async body parsing via readBody(); JSON parse failure returns 400; ApiError mapped to correct HTTP status via apiErrorToStatus(). 13 api-reset.test.ts integration tests + 1040/1040 total tests pass."

comments.note: The route is handled in a dedicated POST block (server.ts lines 351–382) rather than through matchRoute(). This is intentional — the reset endpoint requires async body parsing (readBody()), which the general matchRoute() dispatcher does not support. All 13 integration tests confirm correct HTTP behaviour across every code path.

The decisions guard `!decisions || Object.keys(decisions).length === 0` correctly rejects both a missing decisions map and an explicitly empty one. This is a reasonable guard; the empty-map case is unusual in practice but defensively handled.
